test_title: SSC Selection Post 2024 (Higher Secondary Level) Official Paper (Held On: 25 Jun, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Select the option that represents the letters that, when sequentially placed from left to right in the blanks below, will complete the letter series.

_ V _ D _ B _ _ B D _ _
solution:
Given series: _ V _ D _ B _ _ B D _ _

Option 1) BDDVDVB → __B__ V __D__ D __D__ B __V__ __D__ B D __V__ __B__ → (It doesn't follow any pattern)

Option 2) BDVVBDV → __B__ V __D__ D __V__ B __V__ __B__ B D __D__ __V__ → (It doesn't follow any pattern)

Option 3) DDBVDVB → __D__ V __D__ D __B__ B __V__ __D__ B D __V__ __B__ → (It doesn't follow any pattern)

Option 4) DBVDVVB → __**D**__ V __**B**__ D __**V**__ B __**D**__ __**V**__ B D __**V**__ __**B**__ → (It follows the pattern of: DVB - DVB - DVB - DVB)

Hence, "Option 4" is the correct answer.
